stops.note: named a lesser chief elected to lead a single band, related to Proto-Algonquian 'sakima·wa'
adopted by English colonists in New England to describe local Algonquian leaders
stops.meaning: a chief among northeastern Algonquian peoples

current_meaning: historically, a chief or leader among Algonquian peoples of the northeastern United States; later used as an honorary or jocular title
